Aemĭlĭus Măcer , of Verona,
I.a poet, the friend of Virgil and Ovid, who wrote De Serpentibus et Volucribus (and perh. De Virtutibus Herbarum), of which nothing is extant, Ov. Tr. 4, 10, 43; Serv. ad Verg. E. 5, 1.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
